production_inspect.note: SQL 78 creates public.check_partner_stakeholder_removals, so its owner is the login that runs the file. The tool connects with the pinned checksops_admin secret: the SQL 77 pre-apply inspect (SSM d6aaefb4-c337-4b85-865e-87e8b586d964) read current_user checksops_admin, and the catalog read (SSM 316cfa35-489e-42d1-9957-3bb4b73c8923, connected as checksops_admin) found no superuser or BYPASSRLS role and the table absent. The production rule (scripts/deployment-guard/lib/sql-member-stakeholder-production-apply.mjs, sql78) requires current_user to be expected_table_owner and authenticated not to be a member of it (recursive pg_auth_members, INHERIT FALSE and SET FALSE included) before; after, the new table's owner and current_user equal it, authenticated is still not a member, its non-owner ACL is exactly checksops and authenticated SELECT/INSERT/DELETE granted by it with no grant option, and no column-level UPDATE grant exists on it. These reads sit beside the fingerprint, so 4031dea6… and 3d650a56… are unchanged.
